metadata.title: Land Registry ZKP
metadata.description: Privacy-preserving Land Use Rights registry using Zero-Knowledge Proofs on Ethereum

landing.residentBody: Generate zero-knowledge proofs, verify certificates, or search property history.
landing.govBody: Issue certificates, process property transfers, and publish registry updates on-chain.

gate.title: Registry officer sign-in
gate.intro: The portal key authenticates this browser to the registry API.
gate.label: Portal key
gate.hint: Held for this tab only. Closing it signs you out.
gate.errorRejected: Invalid portal key. Please check and try again.
gate.errorUnreachable: Could not reach the registry API. The key was not checked.
gate.errorUnreachableDetail: Could not reach the registry API. The key was not checked.

govImport.title: Import records
govImport.emptyBody: Drop a .csv export here or browse for one.
govImport.catalogEmptyBody: Commune names in this file could not be checked against the units in force.
govImport.errorsBody: Fix these in the source export and upload the file again.
govImport.noValidRows: No row in this file can be imported.
govImport.committedBody: Imported rows are ready for issuance. {skipped} row(s) were skipped because their property ID was already registered.

govIssuance.title: Issuance
govIssuance.description: Select imported properties, sign the new Merkle root with your wallet, then download the certificate archive.
govIssuance.emptyBody: Import a file first, then come back to draft a batch.
govIssuance.selectAllOnPage: Select every property on this page
govIssuance.archiveWarning: The certificate archive is kept for 7 days. Download and distribute files to owners promptly.
govIssuance.blockedTitle: Change set draft #{id} is waiting to be signed
govIssuance.blockedBody: Only one draft may wait for a signature at a time. Please publish or discard the active draft first.
govIssuance.confirmedTitle: Issuance draft #{id} published at root version {version}
govIssuance.confirmedBody: Download the archive from the list below and hand each property folder to its owner.
govIssuance.discardedTitle: The draft was discarded; its properties are back in the list
govIssuance.historyEmpty: No round has been drafted yet.

govTransfers.title: Transfers
govTransfers.description: Process property transfers at the counter, then approve pending requests in the queue.
govTransfers.counterPrivacy: The seller's secret key is processed only in this browser and never sent to the server. The buyer's key is issued by the authority, as at first issuance.
govTransfers.draftWarning: A draft is waiting to be published. Please finalize or discard it before creating new transfers.
govTransfers.step1Body: Upload the seller's certificate bundle. Verify citizen identity documents before proceeding.
govTransfers.bundle_multiple-properties: The selection contains more than one plot. Select files for a single plot only.
govTransfers.bundle_invalid-json: A file in the bundle is not valid JSON.
govTransfers.bundle_invalid-shape: The files are not a registry receipt and owner secret.
govTransfers.bundle_property-mismatch: receipt.json and secret.json belong to different plots.
govTransfers.issuesTitle: The registry would refuse this transfer
govTransfers.issue_leaf-mismatch: The receipt was altered after issuance: its certificate fields no longer produce its leaf.
govTransfers.issue_secret-mismatch: secret.json does not open the owner commitment in receipt.json.
govTransfers.issue_not-issued: The plot is not currently issued (it may have been revoked).
govTransfers.issue_not-current-owner: This receipt belongs to a previous owner; the plot has changed hands since.
govTransfers.issue_encumbered: The plot is encumbered and cannot be transferred.
govTransfers.issue_community-land: Land held by a residential community cannot be transferred (Điều 39 khoản 2 Luật Đất đai 2024).
govTransfers.abandonAndUnfreeze: Abandon this dossier and lift the freeze
govTransfers.termLabel: Minimum remaining term the buyer accepts (years)
govTransfers.termHint: Enter 0 to only prove it has not expired, or enter an agreed minimum remaining years.
govTransfers.termInvalid: Enter a whole number of years, 0 or more.
govTransfers.termAboveMax: {max} years at most (statutory land allocation limit).
govTransfers.proving: Generating the transfer proof in this browser...
govTransfers.proveFailed: The proof could not be generated
govTransfers.submittedBody: Proof generated in {seconds}s and queued for approval. The buyer's bundle (key file included) will be in the archive of the change set that publishes this transfer, downloadable on the Changes page.
govTransfers.awaitingPublication: Waiting for the next change set
govTransfers.publishedIn: Round #{id} — download the buyer's bundle on the Changes page
govTransfers.approvedTitle: Transfer #{id} approved; will publish with next ChangeSet
govTransfers.rootMismatchHint: The registry published a new root after this proof was made. Please re-submit at the counter. The seller stays frozen until you lift it in the Rejected tab.
govTransfers.staleTimestampHint: Chain timestamp is outdated. Please mine a block and try again.
govTransfers.ownerNotFrozenHint: The seller's freeze is no longer on chain. Sign the freeze again below, then approve.
govTransfers.rejectedStillFrozen: The seller stays frozen until you lift it in the Rejected tab.

govChanges.title: Changes
govChanges.description: Collect approved transfers and revocations into one ChangeSet, sign it, and publish a single new root.
govChanges.emptyBody: Approved transfers and queued revocations collect here, ready to be published.
govChanges.pendingTitle: Waiting for the next change set
govChanges.capNote: A change set carries at most {cap} revocations; remaining requests wait for the next round.
govChanges.loadError: Could not load the pending changes
govChanges.blockedTitle: Issuance draft #{id} is waiting to be signed
govChanges.blockedBody: Only one draft may wait for a signature at a time. Please publish or discard the active issuance draft first.
govChanges.draftDeferred: {count} more revocation(s) wait for the next round (cap of {cap} per change set).
govChanges.revocationsPermanent: Revocations are recorded on chain permanently. Revoked plots can no longer produce any proof.
govChanges.confirmedTitle: Change set #{id} published at root version {version}
govChanges.confirmedBody: The buyers' bundles (key files included) are in this round's archive — download it from the history below.
govChanges.discardedTitle: The draft was discarded; its changes are back in the queue
govChanges.archiveWarning: The buyers' archive can only be downloaded for 7 days. Download it and hand the bundles over promptly.
govChanges.archiveGoneTitle: This archive has expired and was deleted

govRevocations.title: Revocations
govRevocations.description: Queue certificate revocations. A plot leaves the Merkle tree only when the next change set is signed and published.
govRevocations.revokeBody: The request waits here and takes effect when the next change set publishes.
govRevocations.detailHint: Only a cryptographic hash is stored on-chain. Detailed content remains confidential.
govRevocations.detailRequired: Describe the decision this revocation is based on.
govRevocations.pendingTitle: Revocations waiting for the next change set
govRevocations.loadError: Could not load the pending revocations
govRevocations.capNote: A change set carries at most {cap} revocations; remaining requests wait for the next round.

residentProof.title: Generate a proof
residentProof.description: Prove facts about your title without revealing sensitive details. Everything is processed privately on your device.
residentProof.emptyBody: Select the certificate ZIP file (or receipt.json and secret.json) received from the registry.
residentProof.privacyBanner: Privacy Guaranteed: Processing happens entirely on your device. Private keys and certificate details are never uploaded.
residentProof.step1Body: The ZIP you received from the registry, or the two files inside it: receipt.json and secret.json.
residentProof.bundleProblem: That bundle could not be read
residentProof.bundle_missing-secret: secret.json is missing. This key file is required to generate proofs.
residentProof.bundle_multiple-properties: Batch archive detected. Please select files for a single plot only.
residentProof.bundle_invalid-json: One of the files is not valid JSON.
residentProof.bundle_invalid-shape: Those files are not a land-registry bundle.
residentProof.bundle_property-mismatch: The receipt and the secret are for different plots.
residentProof.step2Body: Read directly from your file in this browser. No data was sent to the server.
residentProof.check_leaf: Certificate details match original issue record
residentProof.integrityFailedBody: No proof can be generated from it. Contact the issuing authority.
residentProof.issue_leaf-mismatch: A detail on this certificate was changed after it was issued and no longer matches records.
residentProof.issue_secret-mismatch: This secret.json does not open this certificate. The two files are from different bundles.
residentProof.issue_merkle-mismatch: The registry proof inside this file is damaged.
residentProof.issue_depth-retired: This file was issued under an older system version. Ask the issuing authority for a fresh copy.
residentProof.issue_depth-mismatch: Proof structure is not supported by this registry.
residentProof.issue_property-mismatch: The file disagrees with itself about which plot it describes.
residentProof.staleBundleBody: Your proof was automatically synced with the latest registry updates.
residentProof.rootNotPublishedBody: The registry has pending updates awaiting blockchain publication. Please try again shortly.
residentProof.chainUnavailableBody: Could not reach the blockchain to verify status. Please try again later.
residentProof.supersededBody: This plot has been updated or transferred. Please use the latest certificate file, or check Property History.
residentProof.ownerFrozenTitle: This certificate is frozen by a pending procedure
residentProof.ownerFrozenBody: The land authority has accepted a transfer or a revocation for this plot that is not yet published. Until it is, no proof made from this certificate will be accepted. Contact the authority if you did not expect this.
residentProof.titleExpiredBody: Proofs cannot be generated for expired titles. Renewal goes through the issuing authority.
residentProof.step3: 3. What do you want to prove?
residentProof.step3Body: Select a claim to prove. Only minimal, necessary facts are revealed.
residentProof.typeOwnershipBody: Proves you are the registered owner without revealing your name or certificate details.
residentProof.typeMortgage: Prove title is clean and meets term requirement
residentProof.typeMortgageBody: For banks and lenders. Proves ownership, absence of encumbrances/disputes, and minimum remaining term without exposing exact expiry dates.
residentProof.termHint: Enter whole years as requested by your lender (not your actual remaining term).
residentProof.termInvalid: Enter a whole number of years, 0 or more
residentProof.termTooLong: Exceeds remaining term on your certificate. Please enter a lower number.
residentProof.termAboveMax: {max} years at most (statutory land allocation limit).
residentProof.termPerpetual: This plot is held in perpetuity. Enter the minimum term requested by your lender.
residentProof.mortgageEncumbered: Unavailable: Property currently has an active mortgage, dispute, or restriction.
residentProof.provingHint: Takes a few seconds and runs entirely on this device.
residentProof.resultBody: Share this file with whoever requested verification. It contains no secret key.
residentProof.expiryWarning: Proofs are valid for 10 minutes. If expired, simply generate a new one.

residentVerify.title: Verify a proof
residentVerify.description: Verify a zero-knowledge proof against the blockchain registry and check revocation status.
residentVerify.emptyBody: Upload a proof.json file provided by a property owner to verify its validity.
residentVerify.modeBody_standard: For buyers and lenders: only the proof.json provided by the owner is needed.
residentVerify.modeBody_agency: For auditing agencies: both proof.json and receipt.json of the same plot are required, to also verify the issuing authority. Note: receipt.json discloses address, area, term and encumbrance, so only request it when an audit truly needs it.
residentVerify.inputBody: Upload the proof.json file, or paste its contents below. Checks run locally in your browser.
residentVerify.pasteHint: The JSON the owner downloaded, exactly as it is.
residentVerify.proofProblem: That proof could not be read
residentVerify.proof_invalid-shape: Invalid Groth16 proof format — requires `proof` object and `publicSignals` array.
residentVerify.proof_unknown-circuit: Public signals count does not match any recognized circuit.
residentVerify.proof_circuit-mismatch: Proof metadata mismatch. File may have been edited.
residentVerify.receiptProblem: That receipt could not be used
residentVerify.receipt_invalid-json: The receipt is not valid JSON.
residentVerify.receipt_invalid-shape: This is not a receipt.json issued by the registry (the issuer block is missing).
residentVerify.receipt_property-mismatch: receipt.json belongs to a different plot than the proof.
residentVerify.detected_mortgage: Clean title with minimum remaining term
residentVerify.transferSpentNote: Transfer proofs expire once their ChangeSet is published. RootMismatch afterwards is normal.
residentVerify.checksBody: Checks are executed in order. Verification stops at the first failure.
residentVerify.check_freshnessWhy: Ensures the proof was created recently to prevent reuse of outdated proofs.
residentVerify.check_cryptographicWhy: Verified in your browser using the public verification key.
residentVerify.check_rootMatchesChainWhy: Confirms the proof reflects the current state of the blockchain registry.
residentVerify.check_ownerNotFrozen: Owner not frozen by a pending procedure
residentVerify.check_ownerNotFrozenWhy: A transfer or revocation accepted by the land authority freezes the current owner on the blockchain until it is published, so a certificate that has just been sold or revoked cannot back a new proof.
residentVerify.check_onChainWhy: Independent verification by the LandRegistryVerifier smart contract (gas-free).
residentVerify.blocked_chain-unavailable: Could not connect to blockchain. This check could not run.
residentVerify.blocked_artifacts-missing: Verification key missing locally. On-chain verdict is still available below.
residentVerify.rejected_StaleTimestampBody: Proofs expire after 10 minutes to protect against outdated claims. Please request a newly generated proof.
residentVerify.rejected_InvalidProofBody: Mathematical verification failed. This proof should not be accepted.
residentVerify.rejected_RootMismatch: Proof refers to an older registry state
residentVerify.rejected_RootMismatchBody: The registry has updated since this proof was created. Please request a newly generated proof.
residentVerify.rejected_OwnerFrozen: The owner of this certificate is frozen
residentVerify.rejected_OwnerFrozenBody: The land authority has accepted a transfer or a revocation for this plot that is not yet published. Until it is, this certificate cannot be used for another transaction. Do not proceed; contact the authority.
residentVerify.reason_proof-rejected: One or more verification checks failed.
residentVerify.reason_property-revoked: The certificate behind this plot has been revoked by the land authority.
residentVerify.reason_issuer-mismatch: The registry that published this root is not the expected authority.
residentVerify.reason_issuer-unverified: No trusted root CA is configured in this verifier, so the issuing authority's certificate could not be traced.
residentVerify.reason_chain-unavailable: Could not connect to blockchain to complete checks.
residentVerify.reason_checks-incomplete: Not all verification checks could be completed.
residentVerify.disclosedBody: These are the verified facts. All other property details remain private.
residentVerify.withheldBody: These details are protected by Zero-Knowledge Proof design.
residentVerify.issuerBody: Checked from receipt.json: whether the authority behind the registry is the competent one.
residentVerify.issuerNotChecked: The issuing authority could not be checked.
residentVerify.link_certificate: Issuer certificate was issued by a trusted root CA and is valid
residentVerify.link_certificateRejected: Not issued by the trusted root CA, or outside its validity period.
residentVerify.link_certificateNoAnchor: No trusted root CA is configured in this verifier, so the certificate's origin cannot be checked.
residentVerify.link_signature: Certificate key signed this blockchain address
residentVerify.link_role: Address is authorized to publish registry roots
residentVerify.contractMatches: Receipt matches the registry contract read by this portal
residentVerify.contractMismatch: Warning: Receipt names a DIFFERENT registry contract. Treat with suspicion.

residentLookup.title: Property history
residentLookup.description: View registration history for any parcel by its plot ID. Owners are displayed as secure commitments.
residentLookup.label: Property ID
residentLookup.emptyBody: Enter a property ID (0 to 1,048,575) to view issuance, transfer, and revocation history.
residentLookup.invalidId: Property ID must be a whole number between 0 and 1,048,575.
residentLookup.notFoundBody: Please check the number. No records found for this property ID.
residentLookup.publicTierNote: This page displays public on-chain commitments only. Specific certificate details remain protected.
residentLookup.revokedBannerBody: This plot was revoked on-chain and cannot generate valid ownership proofs.
residentLookup.timelineEmpty: No events recorded for this plot yet.

govDraft.stepNoRole: {account} does not hold STATE_AUTHORITY_ROLE. Select the authorized account in your wallet.

govDraft.pendingTransfers: {count} pending transfer(s) were proven on the previous state. Once published, they will need re-submission.
govDraft.notOnChainYet: Chain does not hold this root yet

govFreeze.freezeBody: From this signature until the next change set publishes, the current owner's certificate cannot back an ownership or mortgage proof that any verifier accepts. The procedure is recorded only after the freeze is on chain.
govFreeze.unfreezeBody: No procedure is open on this plot any more. Lifting the freeze lets the current owner use the certificate again.
govFreeze.loading: Reading the wallet and the registry...
govFreeze.stepConnect: Connect the officer wallet with state-authority role to sign.
govFreeze.stepWrongChain: Wallet is on chain {actual}. This registry requires chain {expected}.
govFreeze.stepNoRole: {account} does not hold STATE_AUTHORITY_ROLE. Select the authorized account in your wallet.
govFreeze.frozenDone: The owner is frozen on chain.
govFreeze.unfreezeBlockedOpen: A procedure is still open on this plot, so the freeze must stay.
govFreeze.unfreezeNotNeeded: This plot's owner is not frozen. Nothing to lift.
govFreeze.openProcedureTransfer: This plot has an open transfer (#{id}). Finish or reject it first.
govFreeze.openProcedureRevocation: This plot has a pending revocation (#{id}). It must be published first.
govFreeze.unfrozenQueueTitle: {count} queued plot(s) are not frozen on chain
govFreeze.unfrozenQueueBody: They were queued before freezing existed, or their freeze was lifted from another session. Sign the freeze before drafting a change set.
govFreeze.unfreezeNoLongerAllowed: A procedure was opened on this plot meanwhile, so the freeze must stay.
